title: RNG Gamble script
features: Generates 3 random numbers between 1 and 100, if all 3 are the same then it's a jackpot
script:
-- [[ WARNING ]]
-- Your console will be filled with outputs.

for i = 1, 1000 do 
  local firstNumber = math.random(1, 100)
local secondNumber = math.random(1, 100)
local thirdNumber = math.random (1, 100)

if firstNumber == secondNumber and secondNumber == thirdNumber then
  warn(string.format("Jackpot!! %d, %d, %d", firstNumber, secondNumber, thirdNumber))
else
  print(string.format("Maybe next time. %d, %d  %d", firstNumber, secondNumber, thirdNumber))
end 
end
